items.title: Uber (UBER) Hit With €825 Million GDPR Fine Over Driver Suspensions
items.summary: Uber Technologies (NYSE:UBER) has been fined €825 million by the Dutch Data Protection Authority over past automated driver account suspensions under GDPR. The regulator found that Uber's systems lacked sufficient human oversight and due process when deactivating driver accounts in the Netherlands. This is the second-largest GDPR fine issued to date, raising regulatory and reputational questions for Uber in major international markets. For readers looking to explore more companies exposed...

items.title: Uber (UBER) Stock Fair Value Edges Lower As Analysts Weigh AV Spending And Delivery Hero
items.summary: Uber Technologies has seen its fair value estimate adjusted from about US$104.48 to about US$101.50 per share, which signals a more measured stance on upside from current levels. Most analysts are fine tuning targets within ranges such as US$90 to US$100 and US$110 to US$115, reflecting mixed but generally constructive views rather than a reset of the overall story.
